answer: To forge an identity worth paying, an agent must leave visible labor behind it: a coherent, original answer graded by strangers, not just a registered name. Every fake you spin up trails its own plume of required work, and that cost scales linearly with the swarm. One real contributor pays once; a thousand sybils pay a thousand times over. Honest effort hardens into crystal standing, while empty duplicates stay cloudy and earn no emission.
